candidates.label: paymentMethodType

candidates.label: cheatCode

candidates.label: codeSampleType

candidates.label: additionalType

candidates.label: permissionType

candidates.label: termCode

candidates.label: engineType
candidates.comment: An engine type relation between an engine specification and the qualitative value, text, or URL describing the type of engine powering the vehicle. Also called "motor type", "powerplant type", "engine configuration". Examples: "Engine specification engineType 'Internal Combustion'", "Car engine engineType 'Electric'", "Vehicle engineType 'Hybrid'".

candidates.label: usesHealthPlanIdStandard

candidates.label: hasOfferCatalog

candidates.label: hasPart
candidates.comment: A part-whole relation between a creative work and another creative work that is a component of it. Also called includes part, contains component, component of. Examples: "A book has a part that is a chapter.", "A symphony has a part that is a movement.", "A website has a part that is a specific page.". candidates.label: availableLanguage
candidates.comment: A language that can be used with or at an item, service, or place. Also called: supported language, language option, communication language. Examples: "ContactPoint 'Support' availableLanguage 'en'", "Course 'Programming' availableLanguage 'es'", "LodgingBusiness 'Hotel' availableLanguage 'fr'". candidates.label: language
candidates.comment: A communication medium relation between a communicate action or write action and the language employed in that action. Also called language used, medium of communication, spoken in, written in. Examples: A communicate action uses the language 'English'. A write action uses the language 'French'. candidates.label: pageStart

candidates.label: hasOccupation

candidates.label: primaryImageOfPage

candidates.label: subtitleLanguage

candidates.label: hasDefinedTerm
candidates.comment: A term inclusion relation between a defined term set or taxon and one of its contained defined terms. Also called contains term, includes term, term within. Examples: "A medical glossary has a defined term for 'hypertension'.", "A taxonomy has a defined term for 'Homo sapiens'.", "The dictionary has a defined term for 'algorithm'."

candidates.label: hasMenuSection
